component-metadata.author: knimeuser
component-metadata.description:
Metanode for application of linear normalization factors.
Normalization factor type can be selected (column or row based normalization is supported). Normalization factors are expected in the last row/column of the provided dataframe. Columns or rows order is not important for columns or rows based normalization, respectively, but their names has to be equal in normalization factors dataframe and in selected columns from input table.
Next to the normalization factor type you should select also mathematial operation that should be done with concrete datamatrix value and normalization factor, e.g. multiplication.
Please note that column or row names in both tables have to match so they can be mapped correctly! The metanode will raise an error in case they will not be matching.
